market.what: Ni separation circuit (Ni SX away from Li/Mn or Ni crystallization) in black-mass hydromet, world
market.method: ~45% of ~$440M separation spend (Ni is ~62% of saponification NaOH: 200 of 320 kg metal/t BM). bottom-up est.: ~600 kt Ni/Co black mass refined (120 kt Ni at ~20% Ni) x ~$735/t separation cost [opex ~$340/t: NaOH saponification ~440 kg x $368/t, strip acid ~540 kg x $123/t, Na2SO4 handling, organic loss; capex charge ~$395/t: 35% SX share x 15%/yr of ~$5k/t-yr Asia or ~$26k/t-yr West (Li-Cycle $0.85-1B/35 kt)]

value.logic: Ni-over-Co/Mn binder cuts Ni circuit cost 40% = $80M + 0.5% more Ni of $1.82B = $9M
value.revenue_logic: $90M x 2.66 (2032 volumes) x 6% adoption x 35% capture

trend.drivers: recycled Ni 112 kt (2024) -> 493 kt (2034); EoL packs overtake scrap by ~2030; Ni-rich NMC
trend.deadline: EU Battery Reg: 90% Ni recovery by 31 Dec 2027; 6% recycled Ni in new batteries from 2031

competition.notes: bis-picolylamine resin M4195 gives 99% Ni purity at pH 1-2 in LIB leach (benchmark to beat); Chinese plants mostly P507 SX

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom Ni ligand, then grafted on silica/resin (3 variants)
lab.test: Ni/Co/Mn/Li selectivity vs pH and isotherms in real NMC leach, column + elution, ICP-OES; university hydromet lab
lab.logic: ligand 6 wk $15-20k + grafting 4 wk $10-15k; test 6 wk ~300 ICP-OES x $40-50 + leach/columns ~$10k

sale.gates: bench on real leach 3-6 mo; recycler pilot 6-12 mo; NiSO4 offtaker qualification 6-12 mo
